    return s[2:] if s.startswith(('0x', '0X')) else s

def hex_to_bytes(s: str, allow_prefix=True) -> bytes:
    if allow_prefix:
        s2 = strip_0x(s)
    else:
        s2 = s
    if len(s2) % 2:
        raise HexParseError('Odd number of digits', caused=True)
    for i, ch in enumerate(s2):
        if ch not in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF':
            # position mirrors the post-optional-prefix string for params; decode data disallows prefix.
            raise HexParseError(f"Invalid character '{ch}' at position {i}", caused=True)
    try:
        return bytes.fromhex(s2)
    except ValueError:
        raise HexParseError('Invalid data')

def word(n: int) -> bytes:
    return (n % (1 << 256)).to_bytes(32, 'big')

def pad_right(b: bytes) -> bytes:
    return b + b'\x00' * ((32 - (len(b) % 32)) % 32)

def split_array_items(s: str):
    if not (len(s) >= 2 and s[0] == '[' and s[-1] == ']'):
        raise ABIError('Invalid data')
    inner = s[1:-1]
    if inner == '':
        return []
    res, cur, depth = [], [], 0
    for ch in inner:
        if ch == '[':
            depth += 1; cur.append(ch)
        elif ch == ']':
            depth -= 1; cur.append(ch)
            if depth < 0: raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        elif ch == ',' and depth == 0:
            res.append(''.join(cur).strip()); cur=[]
        else:
            cur.append(ch)
    if depth != 0: raise ABIError('Invalid data')

def parse_token(t: ABIType, s: str, lenient=False):

            raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        return [parse_token(t.elem, it, lenient) for it in items]
    if t.kind == 'bool':
        sl = s.lower()
        if sl in ('true', '1'): return True
        if sl in ('false', '0'): return False
        raise ABIError('Invalid data')
    if t.kind == 'address':
        b = hex_to_bytes(s, allow_prefix=True)
        if len(b) != 20: raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        return b
    if t.kind == 'bytes_fixed':
        b = hex_to_bytes(s, allow_prefix=True)
        if len(b) != t.size: raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        return b
    if t.kind == 'bytes':
        return hex_to_bytes(s, allow_prefix=True)
    if t.kind == 'string':
        return s
    if t.kind in ('uint', 'int'):
        if lenient:
            try:
                n = int(s, 10)
            except ValueError:
                raise ABIError('Invalid data')
            return n % (1 << 256)
        b = hex_to_bytes(s, allow_prefix=True)
        if len(b) != 32: raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        return int.from_bytes(b, 'big')
    raise ABIError('Invalid data')

# ---- encoding ----
def encode_static(t: ABIType, v) -> bytes:
    if t.kind in ('uint', 'int'):
        return word(int(v))
    if t.kind == 'bool':
        return word(1 if v else 0)
    if t.kind == 'address':
        return b'\x00' * 12 + bytes(v)
    if t.kind == 'bytes_fixed':
        return bytes(v) + b'\x00' * (32 - len(v))
    if t.kind == 'array' and not t.dynamic():
        out = bytearray()
        for x in v:
            out += encode_static(t.elem, x)
        return bytes(out)
    raise ABIError('Invalid data')

def encode_dynamic(t: ABIType, v) -> bytes:
    if t.kind == 'string':
        b = v.encode('utf-8')
        return word(len(b)) + pad_right(b)
    if t.kind == 'bytes':
        b = bytes(v)
        return word(len(b)) + pad_right(b)
    if t.kind == 'array':
        if t.size is None:
            return word(len(v)) + encode_sequence([t.elem] * len(v), v)
        # fixed array whose element is dynamic
        return encode_sequence([t.elem] * len(v), v)
    raise ABIError('Invalid data')

def encode_sequence(types, values) -> bytes:
    head_size = 32 * sum(1 if t.dynamic() else t.static_words() for t in types)
    head = bytearray(); tail = bytearray()
    for t, v in zip(types, values):
        if t.dynamic():
            head += word(head_size + len(tail))
            tail += encode_dynamic(t, v)
        else:
            head += encode_static(t, v)
    return bytes(head + tail)

# ---- decoding ----
def read_word(data: bytes, pos: int) -> int:
    if pos < 0 or pos + 32 > len(data):
        raise ABIError('Invalid data')
    return int.from_bytes(data[pos:pos+32], 'big')

def decode_at(t: ABIType, data: bytes, pos: int):
    if t.kind in ('uint', 'int'):
        return read_word(data, pos)
    if t.kind == 'bool':
        return read_word(data, pos) != 0
    if t.kind == 'address':
        return data[pos+12:pos+32] if pos + 32 <= len(data) else (_raise_invalid())
    if t.kind == 'bytes_fixed':
        if pos + 32 > len(data): raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        return data[pos:pos+t.size]
    if t.kind == 'string':
        n = read_word(data, pos)
        start = pos + 32
        if start + n > len(data): raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        return data[start:start+n].decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
    if t.kind == 'bytes':
        n = read_word(data, pos)
        start = pos + 32
        if start + n > len(data): raise ABIError('Invalid data')
        return data[start:start+n]
    if t.kind == 'array':
        if t.size is None:
            n = read_word(data, pos)
            base = pos + 32
        else:
            n = t.size
            base = pos
        vals = []
        if t.elem.dynamic():
            for i in range(n):
                off = read_word(data, base + 32*i)
                vals.append(decode_at(t.elem, data, base + off))
        else:
            p = base
            step = 32 * t.elem.static_words()
            for i in range(n):
                vals.append(decode_at(t.elem, data, p))
                p += step
        return vals
    raise ABIError('Invalid data')

def _raise_invalid():
    raise ABIError('Invalid data')

def decode_sequence(types, data: bytes):
    vals = []
    pos = 0
    for t in types:
        if t.dynamic():
            off = read_word(data, pos)
            vals.append(decode_at(t, data, off))
            pos += 32
        else:
            vals.append(decode_at(t, data, pos))
            pos += 32 * t.static_words()
    return vals

# ---- display ----
def display_value(t: ABIType, v):
    if t.kind in ('uint', 'int'):
        return format(int(v), 'x')
    if t.kind == 'bool':
        return 'true' if v else 'false'
    if t.kind == 'address':
        return bytes(v).hex()
    if t.kind in ('bytes', 'bytes_fixed'):
        return bytes(v).hex()
    if t.kind == 'string':
        return v
    if t.kind == 'array':
        return '[' + ','.join(display_value(t.elem, x) for x in v) + ']'
    return str(v)

def load_abi(path):
    try:
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception as e:
        raise ABIError(str(e))

def item_inputs(item):
    return [parse_type(x.get('type', '')) for x in item.get('inputs', [])]

def item_outputs(item):
    return [parse_type(x.get('type', '')) for x in item.get('outputs', [])]

def canonical_signature(item, include_outputs=False):
    ins = ','.join(parse_type(x.get('type','')).canonical() for x in item.get('inputs', []))
    base = f"{item.get('name','')}({ins})"
    if include_outputs and item.get('outputs'):
        outs = ','.join(parse_type(x.get('type','')).canonical() for x in item.get('outputs', []))
        base += f":({outs})"
    return base

def lookup_function(abi, name):
    funcs = [x for x in abi if x.get('type') == 'function']
    if '(' in name or ':' in name:
        for f in funcs:
            if name == canonical_signature(f, include_outputs=True):
                return f
        raise ABIError(f"invalid function signature `{name}`")
    found = [f for f in funcs if f.get('name') == name]
    if not found:
        raise ABIError(f"Invalid name: {name}")
    if len(found) > 1:
        raise ABIError(f"More than one function found for name `{name}`, try providing the full signature")
    return found[0]

def lookup_event(abi, name):
    evs = [x for x in abi if x.get('type') == 'event']
    if '(' in name:
        for e in evs:
            if name == canonical_signature(e, include_outputs=False):
                return e
        raise ABIError(f"invalid event signature `{name}`")
    found = [e for e in evs if e.get('name') == name]
    if not found:
        raise ABIError(f"Invalid name: {name}")
    if len(found) > 1:
        raise ABIError(f"More than one event found for name `{name}`, try providing the full signature")
    return found[0]

def function_selector(item):
    return keccak256(canonical_signature(item, include_outputs=False).encode())[:4]

def event_topic(item):
    return keccak256(canonical_signature(item, include_outputs=False).encode())

def cmd_encode_params(argv):

def collect_p_args(rest):
